io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; state updates on the positive edge.

io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous active-high reset; clears the branch history register to zero.

io.name: predict_valid
io.description: When high, a branch prediction is being made; shift predict_taken into the history register.

io.name: predict_taken
io.description: Predicted direction of the branch being predicted; shifted into the LSB of the history register.

io.name: train_mispredicted
io.description: When high, a branch misprediction occurred; load the history register with train_history concatenated with train_taken.

io.name: train_taken
io.description: Actual direction of the mispredicted branch; becomes the new LSB of the history register.

io.name: train_history
io.description: Branch history before the mispredicted branch; forms the upper 32 bits of the restored history.

io.name: predict_history
io.description: Current value of the 32-bit global branch history shift register; predict_history[0] is the youngest branch direction.

functional_summary.overview: 32-bit global branch history shift register with pipeline-flush rollback support. On a branch prediction, the predicted direction is shifted into the LSB. On a branch misprediction, the register is restored to the pre-branch history concatenated with the actual branch outcome. Misprediction takes precedence over prediction when both occur in the same cycle. Asynchronous active-high reset clears the register to zero.
rules: areset is asynchronous and active-high; when asserted, predict_history is reset to 0 regardless of clk.
On the positive clock edge, if train_mispredicted is high, predict_history <= {train_history[30:0], train_taken} (misprediction takes precedence over prediction).
On the positive clock edge, if train_mispredicted is low and predict_valid is high, predict_history <= {predict_history[31:1], predict_taken}.
On the positive clock edge, if neither train_mispredicted nor predict_valid is high, predict_history retains its value.
predict_history[0] represents the direction of the youngest branch.
predict_history is a registered output updated on the positive clock edge (or asynchronously by areset).
